additional_info.subject: ID0426216-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2/R2 312900727026] Charging Station Faulted CRM:02889000018
additional_info.body:
Hi Orel,
I found the problem.
As you can see here, the voltage transducer is not working properly. The idea here is the following:
Check if XD10.1 is fitted properly, it's those orange connectors that come loose. Otherwise, check from XD41 if the voltage is reaching properly and also to KF8.
Take a spare TF5 in case it needs replacement.
Let me know if you need help.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0426216-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2/R2 312900727026] Charging Station Faulted CRM:02889000018
additional_info.body:
